notes: The LD65ELY5 has an electronic control panel and a solenoid valve; the spec table shows no solenoid valve for the 30- and 40-pint models. Some parts lists also carry Goldstar-branded variants.

gaps: The supply voltage and the 850 W / 8.3 A are whole-unit figures, so they are not put on any part.
method: Source is LG's own dehumidifier service manual (P/No 3828A31001, dated January 2005) covering DH300EY5/DH305Y5/DH300MY5, LD40Y5/DH400MY5, DH404EY5/DH400EY5/LD40EY5, DH504ELY5/LD50ELY5 and LD65ELY5.
It is hosted as a PDF by the parts retailer Appliance Factory Parts, which adds its own cover sheet as PDF page 1; page numbers below are PDF pages.
Read as text and checked against a rendered image of the spec table (PDF p.5) on 2026-11-12.
LD65ELY5 figures: 65 pints/24 h, 1-phase 115 V 60 Hz, 850 W input, 8.3 A running current, R22 refrigerant, 8.46 oz (240 g) charge (spec table, PDF p.5).
LD65ELY5 parts: circuit-diagram parts table (PDF p.13) and replacement parts list (PDF p.34).
The solenoid valve is drawn as a reversing coil in the circuit diagram.
The fan is listed as a shaded-pole motor, and the parts list carries a single capacitor.

comps.spec: Rotary compressor, model QA114CBD; LG service part 'compressor (rotary), set' 2520UCBA007; R22 refrigerant, charge 8.46 oz (240 g)
Capacitor 35 uF 270 VAC, LG part 0CZZA20005J; wired to the compressor in the circuit diagram; held by a screw in the control box
Shaded-pole fan motor 91 W / 1.8 A with 266 F (130 C) thermal cutoff, LG motor assembly 4681A20040K; turbo fan 5900A20007A
Bucket micro switch assembly 15 A / 250 VAC, LG part 6600A30003C; shuts the unit off when the bucket is full
Sensor assembly, LG part 6877A30013L: humidity sensor plus a thermistor (spec table: thermistor opens at 33.8 F / 1 C and closes at 50 F / 10 C), wired to the main PCB
Solenoid valve coil assembly, LG part 6421A20003K, rated 7 W / 90 mA
Main PWB (PCB) assembly, LG part 6871A10141C; separate display PWB assembly 6871A20482A

sources.title: LG dehumidifier service manual, models DH300EY5 to LD65ELY5 (LG P/No 3828A31001, January 2005), PDF hosted by Appliance Factory Parts
